body: Works great now 🙂 Very small texture sizes seem to render correctly too. However, the decal filter project setting is currently not used, even after a restart. This means you can't use one of the Nearest values of the `rendering/textures/decals/filter` project setting to have pixel art decals like in Forward+/Mobile. Blending also looks different between Forward+ and Compatibility, not sure if we can do something about it: Forward+ | Compatibility -|- | In particular, the translucent Godot icon (the leftmost one) is significantly less visible in Compatibility compared to Forward+. It uses the default modulate color and **Albedo Mix** set to `0.5`. The scene above uses no lights, an unshaded material and linear tonemapping, so it should look as close as possible between renderers otherwise. **Testing project:** [test_pr_118070.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26681825/test_pr_118070.zip)
Works great now, including anisotropic filtering and bilinear/trilinear filtering 🙂
I wanted to make further suggestions but then I noticed to my dismay that the surrounding descriptions are worded exactly like this, which would have made this description inconsistent.
Implementation looks solid to me. The RD code is adapted over correctly. There are some TODOs in the code though, are you gonna be doing those?
Tested on PC and Android on a custom project. I tried animating decals, adding too many to the scene, I couldn't find an issue. My test project was quite simple, but i couldn't spot any issue.
